name: WP Rate And Review
author: krishna121

sections.description:
WP Rate And Review enhances your WooCommerce product pages by displaying attractive and customizable rating and review summaries. It provides a modern and professional way to showcase customer feedback with visually engaging progress bars and detailed rating statistics.

The plugin gives you full control over design components directly from the settings panel, allowing you to customize how ratings and reviews appear on your product detail pages.

Features

  • Display rating progress bars inside the product review tab.
  • Enable or disable the rating progress bar feature.
  • Show rating counts for each star level (1–5 stars) with option to enable/disable.
  • Display complete rating and review summary including average product rating.
  • Show total number of submitted reviews.
  • Show total number of submitted ratings.
  • Fully customizable progress bar colors from the settings page.
  • Use shortcode [wp_rate_review product_id=”product_ID”] to display rating and review summary anywhere on pages or posts.

sections.installation:
1. Log-in to your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Go to plugins page and click on Add New button.
  3. Upload plugin’s zip file from your computer and activate plugin.
  4. Now you could see “WP Rate And Review” into dashboard menu.
